raw: {"analysis": "TNT's plan better aligns with the ticket's cost-control and approval constraints: it places design lead and accessibility officer review before any CI run, preventing expensive snapshot builds on unapproved changes. SHP runs CI before the dual approval, risking wasted CI credits if the design lead rejects the visual changes. TNT also provides a clear human decision point for snapshot failures and a straightforward rollback plan, while SHP's extra spec phase adds overhead without addressing the core sequencing issue.", "verdict": "TNT"}
